summary: Iteration 5 end-to-end verification of the Communications Strategist Desk upgrades. All 6 requested features pass. Sidebar: 6 Core items render by default (nav-daily-desk, nav-content-desk, nav-narrative-room, nav-founder-exec-comms, nav-product-customer-stories, nav-opportunity-radar); More is collapsed on home, nav-more-toggle reveals 7 secondary items (nav-integrated-launch, nav-campaign-studio, nav-people-culture, nav-reputation-media, nav-impact-learning, nav-agent-room, nav-source-library); visiting /campaigns keeps More expanded; mobile drawer has m-nav-more-toggle that reveals m-nav-agent-room. Daily Desk: my-desk section sits ABOVE the ANA briefing card with three sub-panels my-decisions / my-questions / my-next-actions; after recording a decision in Content Desk the entry 'Keep as draft: TEST: iter5 kept as draft after accepting one agatha edit (v2)' appears in my-decisions, and 'TEST: verify freudenberg attribution details with the account team' appears in my-questions under 'Fact check · ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE HAS A DOCUMENTATION PROBLEM'. Content Desk FULL workflow on Freudenberg draft 01054c5e-... (v1, no prior decision): route-review-btn ran AGATHA + BERDINE fresh (both rendered agatha-sentences, berdine-use-version, 98 post-chips, 3 run-received panels); run-btn-ana-synthesis rendered ana-decisions; accepted agatha-0 and apply-accepted-btn produced v2 (117 words, source=accepted_suggestions); recorded decision 'Keep as draft' with 'TEST: iter5...' reasoning on v2; after reload decision-history visible, judgement-status='DECISION RECORDED', editor still at v2. Founder room /founder: loaded example workspace, pasted the sample paragraph into ws-founder_notes, ran run-btn-edith-founder_notes (~55s). Output labelled items as DIRECT QUOTE, PARAPHRASE, INTERPRETATION; the verbatim '"Documentation is always out of date the day it is published."' tagged DIRECT QUOTE; status reads 'Captured notes, not approved for publication'; explicit SIGN OFF NEEDED FROM section calls out Jan Philipp Haas before any public use. Nothing invented beyond the pasted notes. Opportunity Radar /radar: research-mode-banner says 'Live research: connected (Claude web search via the Emergent key)'; run-btn-live-research returned live-results with 17 live-result-* items (~2 min), each rendered dates, deadline, cost, source URL as clickable link, and secondary-source chip; live-save-0 saved SAP TechEd (https://dev.events/sap) with verification=live_secondary into radar; selecting that opp via opp-row in the 'All' tab opens radar-detail that shows 'LIVE SEARCH · SECONDARY SOURCE, VERIFY' chip, the dev.events source link, and 'DEVELOP A CAMPAIGN IDEA WITH DIANA' card with Run (not executed). Backend: GET /api/ returns {web_research: 'anthropic_web_search', llm: 'configured'}; successful catherine.live_research runs have top-level web_search=true (verified for run 8ebd8423).
critical_code_review_comments: Radar.jsx: a saved live-search opportunity is only visible under 'all' tab because its initial status is 'new' (default 'verified' tab filters it out). After live-save-N, consider auto-switching to the tab that contains the newly saved item, or seed verification='live_secondary'/'live_official' into the verified-list filter so users can see what they just saved.
ContentDesk.jsx MyDecision statusMap couples strategist decision labels to draft status strings (unchanged from iter4) - still worth extracting next to DECISIONS constant.
Shell.jsx: nav-more-toggle has no aria-expanded attribute; adding it would improve accessibility.

Shell.jsx: on mobile drawer, after clicking a More item the drawer closes (via location-change effect) but moreOpen state resets on next open only if inMore. For users on routes NOT in More, state is reset to collapsed - fine, but keeping moreOpen sticky across sessions (localStorage) could reduce friction.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All six features of the review request work end-to-end. LLM usage this iteration: 1 AGATHA review + 1 BERDINE review + 1 ANA synthesis + 1 edith.founder_notes + 1 catherine.live_research = 5 real LLM runs. Freudenberg draft is now v2 draft with recorded TEST: decision; to re-run the record-decision flow in a future iteration, either delete decision via PUT /api/c/drafts/{id} or clone the draft. live_research banner text matches 'Live research: connected' (CSS uppercases it when rendered). Radar 'all' tab (opp-tab-all) is needed to find newly-saved live items because default is 'verified'. edith.founder_notes items use kinds from {DIRECT QUOTE, PARAPHRASE, INTERPRETATION, NEEDS SIGN-OFF}; NEEDS SIGN-OFF is often rendered as a separate 'SIGN OFF NEEDED FROM' section rather than per-item label when founder notes themselves are small.
